title: FIA spectrophotometric method for amoxicillin determination in pharmaceuticals
author: Falih, Abbas, et al.
materials: Stock for the batch and FIA techniques, standard AMX and Dap solutions (1000 µg/mL) were made by dissolving 0.1 g of pure AMX and Dap powder into 100 mL of distilled water, (25 %)NaOH, and (1 %) NaNO2.

steps.title: Prepare AMX and Dap stock solutions
steps.instruction: Dissolve 0.1 g of pure amoxicillin and 0.1 g of pure dapsone each in 100 mL distilled water containing 25 % (v/v) NaOH and 1 % (w/v) NaNO₂ to obtain 1000 µg mL⁻¹ stock solutions for batch and FIA methods.

steps.title: Set up batch diazotization reaction
steps.instruction: In a 25 mL graduated flask placed in an ice bath (0–5 °C), add 1 mL of the 1000 µg mL⁻¹ Dap stock and 1 mL of (1:1) HCl, then slowly add 1 mL of 1 % NaNO₂, wait 20 min, add 1 mL of the 1000 µg mL⁻¹ AMX stock and 1.6 mL of 25 % NaOH (or, using the optimized conditions, add 1 mL of 0.144 M NaNO₂ and 1.5 mL of 6.25 M NaOH), mix thoroughly, dilute to volume with distilled water, and measure absorbance at 440 nm against a blank.

steps.title: Prepare FIA reagent streams
steps.instruction: Prepare three carrier solutions: (i) Channel 1 containing Dap at 4 × 10⁻³ mol L⁻¹; (ii) Channel 2 containing HCl at 0.6 mol L⁻¹ and NaNO₂ at 1.3 × 10⁻³ mol L⁻¹; (iii) Channel 3 containing 1 M NaOH. Connect the channels in a T‑form mixer to generate the carrier stream.

steps.title: Inject sample into FIA system
steps.instruction: Inject 100 µL of a 1 mol L⁻¹ AMX solution into the combined carrier stream.

steps.title: Conduct reaction in coil and detect
steps.instruction: Allow the mixed stream to flow through a 100 cm reaction coil, then through an injector where it reacts with the 1 M NaOH stream at a flow rate of 3 mL min⁻¹ per channel; record the maximum orange‑color absorbance at 440 nm.

steps.title: Apply optimal FIA parameters
steps.instruction: Operate the FIA system with a flow rate of 3 mL min⁻¹, reaction coil length of 100 cm, HCl concentration of 0.6 mol L⁻¹ (within the studied range 0.2–20.7 mol L⁻¹), Dap concentration of 4 × 10⁻³ mol L⁻¹ (range 1.5 × 10⁻³–6.5 × 10⁻³ mol L⁻¹), and NaNO₂ concentration of 1.3 × 10⁻³ mol L⁻¹ (range 0.4 × 10⁻³–2 × 10⁻³ mol L⁻¹).
